newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai central bank cancels Friday notes auctions.
newsitem.headline: Thai central bank cancels Friday notes auctions.

text.p: The Bank of Thailand on Thursday said it had cancelled three weekly notes auctions worth a total of five billion baht scheduled for Friday (June 20).
"Due to changing market liquidity, the Bank of Thailand called off the auction for the bonds," the central bank said in a statement.
Money market dealers said liquidity had tightened in the domestic system amid a rush to buy dollars after Finance Minister Amnuay Viravan resigned.
This had forced overnight interbank rates to rise and prompted the central bank to refrain from mopping up more liquidity from the market through the auctions, they said.
